comments: 3fbda5d0: ;Skip control code - go to label BEGIN
905ce26e: ;Initialise variables to put fields into DE array ready for editing
9a42fd59: ;Set DE nodes from existing fields in file
b067104e: ;Tidy up and quit if no data items exist
68edebd5: ;Display data label and prompt
b64f1380: ;Quit (no code)
75fe2ec1: ;Call reader and output current answer
daef182b: ;If word-wrapping is allowed then go to reader (RW^DIR2)
a9f28b59: ;If not an editable field then display message and quit
b9be8f2a: ;Read in new data, set timeout error and bell if no response
63f6f196: ;Quit (no code)
8d035348: Initialize the processing queue.
2d4f3a60: Go to the current entry in the queue.
1d5a5e09: If an input transform is defined, execute it. Otherwise, process writes and conditionals.
8c5b0378: If no input, branch based on DV: to A if not required, to X if required and allowed, or continue processing if required and not allowed.
c876b988: If input is a question mark, go to reader help. If input is an up-arrow, perform deletions and branch.
bdbe987a: If input is an at-sign, perform deletions and branch to the DIEZQUERI routine.
510f1b6f: If input is a space, and the field has a DEFAULT value defined, display that value unless the DISABLE REVISION DATA or SUPPRESS REVISION DATA properties are set.
555ef2b3: Branch to input transform, validator, cross-reference, conditional branching, or process lookups defined for the field.
5ba80d79: Loop through lookup values, executing validation code and quit when a match is found.
aac7e2c6: Write out any remaining text from the lookup value and set X to the external value.
02ffca5a: If the value is entered, call the FileMan Input Transformation and store the result in X. If X is negative (indicating an error), quit.
3b5c6252: If the value is not numeric, go to the next validation. If the decimal portion of the value is longer than 24 characters, remove the value from X and go to the next validation.

6ebce423: If the value is a floating-point number and the field is not a computed expression, remove leading and trailing zeroes from the decimal portion of the value. If the decimal portion is empty and there is a decimal point, convert the value to an integer.
1b26edba: Store the value of X in DG(DW) if X is defined and not undefined, and conditionally store X in ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB). Then kill YS and go to label A.
eff16386: Kill DIC("S") and DLAYGO. If X is defined and not undefined, store X in DG(DW). If DV contains "d", store X in ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB). Then go to label A.
21bcc7ec: If not running in TaskMan (ZTQUEUED is not defined), write "??" to the current device. If DB(DQ) is defined, branch to label Z^DIE17.
cd1b39e7: Set X to the string "?BAD".
5720184b: Set DZ to X, call label D, call QQ^DIEQ, and go to label B.
8cc436d3: Set D to DIFLD, and set DQ(DQ) to a string containing DLB, DV, DU, DW, and the second piece of the routine text label X_DQ.
0444553b: If DE(DQ) is not defined, call label O. If X does not equal "@", go to RD. If DV does not contain "R" and X equals "@", go to A. If X equals "@", set X to Y and go to N.
05aef346: Set DG to DV, Y to DE(DQ), and X to DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute the code stored in DQ(DQ,2). Then go to RP.

c5446279: If DG contains "P" and the zero node of the global root X exists, set X to the value at the second piece of that node. If the Y node of that global does not exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to the value at the first piece of that node, X to the value at the third piece of the 0.01 field of the DD for that file, and DG to the value at the second piece of that node. Then go to R.

a3d8308a: If DG contains "V" and Y is a number, the second piece of Y delimited by ';' contains '(', and the zero node of the global root formed by concatenating U and the second ';'-delimited piece of Y exists, set X to the value at the second piece of that node. If the Y node of that global does not exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to the value at the first piece of that node. If the 0.01 field of the DD for the file specified by X is defined, set DG to the value at the second piece of that node and X to the value at the third piece of that node. Then go to R.

28b5f1e4: If DG contains 'D', execute ^DD("DD"). If DG contains 'S', set the % variable to the second ';'-delimited piece of the string formed by concatenating ';', X, ';', Y, and ':'. If % is not null, set Y to %.
26181d73: Call label O. If X is null, set X to DE(DQ). If DV is null, go to A. If DC is less than 2, go to A. Otherwise, go to N^DIE17.
93bd476c: If the input data value does not contain 'I' or '#', go to label RD (Read Data).
6425aaa9: Perform input transform on the data value. If the transformed value exists in the X array, go to label RD. Otherwise, go to label PR (Print Data).
1f6a6ce5: Quit the program.
02b1adc5: Set the variable DNM to 'DGJXA4' and DQ to 1. DNM likely represents a routine name, and DQ is a loop counter.

3d824ea7: If the DG array has more than 9 nodes, perform special processing by calling F^DIE17, then DE. Set DQ to 1, DW to 'DT;6', DV to 'P200'', DU to an empty string, DLB to 'SIGNED BY', and DIFLD to 10.06. These variables likely control input validation and field descriptions.
0df6ae73: Set the DE(DW) array node to 'C1^DGJXA4', which is likely a routine and label reference for input transform.
24be8406: Set the DU variable to 'VA(200,', which is likely used for file/global array references.
bac5ae5d: Go to label RE (Read Entry).
10bf694e: If the DE(1) array node exists, go to label C1S (Computed 1 Special). Otherwise, set X to DE(1), and DIC to DIE (input variables). This is likely for input validation.
9dd7748b: Set the DGJFREV variable to 1, and call the PHYDEF^DGJTUTL routine. This is likely for special processing related to physicians or providers.
b1f39378: Set X to an empty string. If DG(DQ) equals X, quit. Otherwise, set X to DG(DQ), and DIC to DIE. This is likely for input validation.
157c2bcb: Set the DGJFREV variable to 1, and call the PHYDEF^DGJTUTL routine. This is likely for special processing related to physicians or providers.
efaf3059: Quit the program.
27fb577d: Quit if no action is chosen.
0280fb35: Check if data field exists. Set flag and call UPDATE^DIE routine. Store user response (Y). Quit if no action is chosen.
033e9de8: Clear the 5th node of the 0 subfile for this record if response is null, and set related fields.
8820888d: Check if data field exists. Set flag and call UPDATE^DIE routine. Store user response (Y). Quit if no action is chosen.
ff88f901: Set related field for updating record.
74db42cc: Quit.
229b19ec: Check if data field exists. Set flag and call UPDATE^DIE routine. Store user response (Y). Quit if no action is chosen.
3a280d78: If the 3rd piece of DGJTDEL is not 1, set related field and response.
ac956972: Set flags for editing the DATE REVIEWED field.
63b9bf6c: Set input transform for the DATE REVIEWED field.
eb1d6b5b: Branch to input transform.
080f2efe: If a lower node exists, get its value for X and set DIC to the MUMPS global containing that value.
0f081f9b: Set DGJREVD flag to indicate a revision and call the PHYDEF^DGJTUTL routine.
327fa91a: If DG(DQ) has a value, get that value for X and set DIC to the MUMPS global containing that value.
bc4b87fe: Set DGJREVD flag to indicate a revision and call the PHYDEF^DGJTUTL routine.
ee1bbcc8: Exit this section of code.
960694e9: Set the system date/time in external format into X. If date/time is invalid, set X to null.
8ca8f8fa: Exit this section of code.

1c4cd862: If DG array has more than 9 nodes, call F^DIE17 and DE routines. Set Y to up-arrow, DQ to 7, call X7 routine. If Y is null or up-arrow, set X to Y, DIC(0) to 'F', DW to DQ value, and go to OUT^DIE17.
ecd4333a: If X is not null and is less than the DATE DICTATED field (#.01) of the VAS(393 global, display error message and set the external value for that field to null and Y to '@7'.
8cd7cbf4: Exit this section of code.

0fbb9dde: If the DG array is defined and DG is greater than 9 do the F^DIE17 and DE subroutines. Set Y equal to the up-arrow character. Set DQ equal to 8 and invoke the X8 subroutine. If Y is equal to the up-arrow character or Y is undefined, go to the A label, otherwise set X equal to Y, set the DIC(0) variable to 'F', and set DW equal to DQ. Go to the OUT^DIE17 subroutine.
c9ec0d29: If X is blank, set DGJTST to 'SIGNED' and Y to '@2'.
b77edc62: Exit X8 subroutine.
fee0f259: If the DG array is defined and DG is greater than 9, do the F^DIE17 and DE subroutines. Set DQ equal to 9, DW to 'DT;8', DV to 'P200', DU to blank, DLB to 'REVIEWED BY', and DIFLD to 10.08.
8784154f: Set DE(DW) to 'C9^DGJXA4'.
e647b178: Go to the RE label.
2a2338cb: If DE(9) is undefined, go to the C9S label. Otherwise, kill DB, set X equal to DE(9), and set DIC equal to DIE.
5ab666d9: Set DGJREVD to 1 and invoke the PHYDEF^DGJTUTL subroutine.
b5191fad: Set X to blank. If DG(DQ) equals X, quit. Otherwise, kill DB, set X equal to DG(DQ), and set DIC equal to DIE.
10072deb: Set DGJREVD to 1 and invoke the PHYDEF^DGJTUTL subroutine.
5effddc8: Exit C9S subroutine.
